results.title: Warm pool management and spot GPUs
highlights:
Warm pool management and spot GPUs

AUG 18 2026

# Warm pool management and spot GPUs

Daytona 0.205.0 introduces warm pool management APIs across SDKs, adds spot GPU support and sandbox OpenTelemetry endpoint override, and improves CLI and TypeScript SDK behavior.

### Features

SDK: warm pool management across SDKs

Sandbox: add spot GPU support

Sandbox: add otelEndpointOverride to sandbox creation

### Fixes

CLI: do not load .env from the working directory

TypeScript SDK: export Snapshot and PaginatedSnapshots types

### Chores

sync go.sum for v0.204.0

batch dependabot 20260811

Go SDK: bump to v0.205.0

highlights:
Sandbox class and warm pool fields on Sandbox

AUG 24 2026

# Sandbox class and warm pool fields on Sandbox

Daytona 0.207.0 surfaces additional sandbox metadata on the Sandbox object so SDKs can read class, warm pool, GPU, state, daemon, and OpenTelemetry override fields directly.

### Features

SDK: expose sandboxClass, warmPoolId, gpuType, desiredState, daemonVersion, and otelEndpointOverride on Sandbox

### Chores

Go SDK: bump to v0.207.0

# Snapshot operations by name and outbound proxy

Daytona 0.204.0 expands snapshot management by ID or name, adds outbound proxy configuration on sandbox create, and introduces typed git transport error codes across all SDKs.
